# Living Proof Creative
> Living Proof Creative delivers innovative, handcrafted Brand & Digital Experiences grounded in Creativity, Expert Ability, Reliability, and Likeability.
As a full-service Creative Agency, we bring goals to life through thoughtful and impactful Website Design & eCommerce Development, User Experience Optimization, and Data-Driven Marketing Solutions.
## Services
- [business consulting services](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/business-consulting-services/): Business consulting services provide comprehensive support in branding, web design, SEO, web development, and e-commerce strategy to help clients build a compelling online presence for growth.
- [Design Services](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/branding-collateral-design/): Design Services from Living Proof Creative deliver branding and collateral design solutions that help businesses build a strong and recognizable identity.
- [Content Marketing Services](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/content-marketing-services/): Content Marketing Services offer strategic content creation and distribution—blog writing, email campaigns, and social media—to help businesses engage their audience and drive growth.
- [UX Design Services](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/ux-design-services/): UX Design Services deliver user-centered strategies, wireframes, and usability testing to create intuitive and impactful digital experiences.
- [Web Development Services](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/creative-web-development/): Web Development Services deliver custom, creative web solutions through platforms like Magento and WordPress, providing tailored development and responsive design for standout online presence.
- [Ecommerce Services](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/ecommerce-services/): Ecommerce Services deliver comprehensive consultancy, web development, marketing, and SEO for tailored e-commerce strategies that drive growth.
- [Digital Marketing Services](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/digital-marketing-services/): Digital Marketing Services provide performance-driven strategies, including SEO, PPC, social media, content marketing, and email automation to help businesses grow and engage their audience.
- [SEO Services](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/seo-search-engine-optimization/): SEO Services deliver tailored strategies, from audits and content optimization to link-building and ongoing maintenance, to boost visibility and drive ROI for businesses.
- [Email Marketing Automation Services](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/email-marketing-automation/): Email Marketing Automation Services automate messaging through tools like newsletters and drip campaigns to deliver the right content at the right moment and free businesses to focus on growth.
- [Technical SEO Services](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/technical-seo-services/): Technical SEO Services optimize site speed, crawlability, and backend structure through audits and technical fixes to improve search visibility and revenue.
- [Local SEO](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/local-seo/): Local SEO helps businesses boost visibility and revenue through location-specific strategies like GMB optimization, NAP consistency, local link-building, and review management.
- [Paid Ads Management Services](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/paid-ads-management/): Paid Ads Management Services optimize ad platforms like PPC and social media with daily monitoring, transparent reporting, and data-driven adjustments to maximize ROI.  
- [Social Media Marketing](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/social-media-marketing/): Social Media Marketing builds brand awareness and engagement with tailored strategies, content calendars, platform targeting, and creative campaigns to connect businesses with their audience.
- [Graphic Design Services](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/creative-graphic-design/): Graphic Design Services deliver tailored visual branding assets—from logos and brochures to packaging and promotional visuals—to help businesses stand out and convey their identity.
- [Austin SEO Services](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/austin-seo-service/): Austin SEO Services deliver local SEO expertise focused on Austin-specific strategies—targeted keywords, audits, on-page optimization, technical fixes, and link building—to boost local search visibility and drive leads.
## Agency Process
- [our process](https://livingproofcreative.com/our-process/#discover): Our process begins with a discovery phase that combines audience analysis, competitive insights, and content evaluation to understand your needs and help your brand shine.
- [Our Design Process](https://livingproofcreative.com/our-process/#design): Our Design Process is a holistic, brand-aligned approach including brand identity, interface design, and collateral creation to ensure consistency and impact across all touchpoints.
- [Our Develop Process](https://livingproofcreative.com/our-process/#develop): Our Develop Process builds the site’s infrastructure using platforms like WordPress, Magento, Drupal, and Heroku, focusing on content management, e-commerce functionality, responsive design, and quality assurance for seamless digital performance.
- [our deploy process](https://livingproofcreative.com/our-process/#deploy): our deploy process launches projects with secure hosting, CDN integration, and ongoing support to ensure stability, speed, and seamless digital performance.

## Solutions
- [Website Development](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/magento-development/): Magento Website Development delivers fully customized, scalable Magento storefronts with expert UI/UX design, seamless integrations, migration support, and robust performance optimization for high-impact e-commerce solutions.
- [Migration](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/magento-migration/): Magento Migration ensures a seamless, secure transition to Magento 2 (or from other platforms) through data migration, compatibility audits, testing, customization, and ongoing support.
- [Support and Maintenance Service](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/magento-support-services/): Magento Support and Maintenance Service offers responsive, 24/7 support including auditing, bug fixes, updates, performance tuning, hosting optimization, and extension maintenance to keep your online store secure and running smoothly.
- [Retail Omnichannel Solution](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/magento-b2b-retail-omnichannel-solution/): Retail Omnichannel Solution integrates online and offline B2B retail operations—unifying inventory, orders, customer accounts, POS, shipping, and reporting via Magento Commerce for a seamless customer experience.
- [SEO Services](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/magento-seo-services/): Magento SEO Services employ advanced, Magento-specific SEO tactics—including in-depth audits, technical and on-page optimization, and link-building—to boost organic rankings and e-commerce visibility.
- [Sage 300 integration](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/magento-sage-300-integration/): Magento Sage 300 Integration delivers a bi-directional sync between Magento and Sage 300, automating inventory, orders, products, and customer data for streamlined B2B/B2C operations.
- [shopify to magento migration](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/shopify-to-magento-migration/): Shopify to magento migration ensures a seamless transfer from Shopify to Magento, combining data migration, design continuity, SEO-safe redirects, testing, training, and support to future-proof and scale your e-commerce platform.
- [woocommerce to magento migration](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/woocommerce-to-magento-migration/): woocommerce to magento migration facilitates a secure, seamless transition from WooCommerce to Magento 2 through comprehensive data export, design continuity, SEO-safe redirects, testing, training, and post-launch support.
- [OpenCart to Magento](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/opencart-to-magento-migration/): OpenCart to Magento migration transforms OpenCart stores into scalable Magento marketplaces with seamless platform transitions, including data migration, performance upgrades, and future-focused eCommerce growth.
- [BigCommerce to Magento Migration](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/bigcommerce-to-magento/): BigCommerce to Magento Migration enables a seamless platform switch by securely transferring data, preserving design, and offering testing, SEO-safe redirects, training, and post-launch support for scalable e-commerce growth.
- [WooCommerce SEO Services](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/woocommerce-seo-services/): WooCommerce SEO Services optimize product and category pages, fix technical SEO issues like duplicate content and site speed, and refine keyword strategy to drive visibility, conversions, and organic traffic for WooCommerce stores.
- [Wordpress Services](https://livingproofcreative.com/wordpress/): Wordpress Services provide custom, user-friendly WordPress websites enhanced with tailored plugins, comprehensive SEO setup, and reliable hosting for optimal performance and visibility.
- [WordPress eCommerce](https://livingproofcreative.com/wordpress-ecommerce-solution/): WordPress eCommerce combines WordPress with e-commerce functionality through custom plugins and POS integration, enabling mobile-friendly, user-manageable sites with initial SEO setup, order management, CRM integration, and centralized reporting to convert and grow.
- [WordPress SEO Services](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/wordpress-seo-service/): WordPress SEO Services begin with a comprehensive SEO audit and analysis to develop a custom optimization strategy—covering on-page elements, technical improvements, content guidance, and ongoing reporting—to drive higher rankings, visibility, and valuable traffic.
- [Web Hosting](https://livingproofcreative.com/services/dedicated-web-hosting/): Web Hosting provides reliable hosting solutions—from shared plans to dedicated servers with 99 % uptime, optimized for WordPress, Magento e-commerce, and custom site needs.
